theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ∀ (F : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) P) (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m), IsSmoothForm ω → latticeFaceAction ρ F (exteriorDerivative ω) = ∑ i : Fin (m + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) * (latticeFaceAction ρ (F.1 + Pi.single (F.2 i) 1, (Fin.succAboveOrderEmb i).trans F.2) ω - latticeFaceAction ρ (F.1, (Fin.succAboveOrderEmb i).trans F.2) ω)
